correct_query: SELECT title FROM (SELECT LHS.code AS code, LHS.n AS n, RHS.title AS title FROM (SELECT * FROM (SELECT code, COUNT(*) AS n FROM Assignment GROUP BY code) WHERE n >= 3) AS LHS INNER JOIN Project AS RHS ON LHS.code = RHS.code) ORDER BY title

expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.description: Mutant flattens grouped count subquery into HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 and omits ORDER BY title
expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.query: SELECT T1.title FROM Project AS T1 JOIN Assignment AS T2 ON T1.code = T2.code GROUP BY T2.code HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
